name: Scope Then Execute
description: Full think→plan→review→execute cycle. Runs scope review before implementation, pre-flight check, execution, verification, and retro. Inspired by gstack's sprint methodology.
context_rules: Always challenge scope before execution. Never skip the review gate. If scope concerns are P0, block execution until resolved.

steps.name: Scope Review Gate
steps.description: Challenge the scope before writing any code. Is this the right size? Expand, hold, or reduce.
steps.instruction: Run the ceo-scope-review skill. Present four modes: SCOPE EXPANSION, SELECTIVE EXPANSION, HOLD SCOPE, SCOPE REDUCTION. Wait for user's mode selection, then run the review. Save revised scope before proceeding.
steps.verification: User selected a scope mode AND revised scope document was produced
steps.validation_prompt: Was a scope mode selected and a revised scope document produced?

steps.name: Pre-Flight Review
steps.description: Run architecture, security, and design checks before implementation
steps.instruction: Run the pre-flight-review skill on the revised scope. Auto-detect which reviews apply (scope, architecture, security, design). Surface only taste decisions. Auto-fix obvious mechanical issues.
steps.verification: All P0 issues resolved. At most 3 P1 issues remaining. Pre-flight verdict: READY or CONDITIONAL.
steps.validation_prompt: Did pre-flight review complete with verdict READY or CONDITIONAL? Are there any P0 blocking issues?

steps.name: Execute Implementation
steps.description: Build what was scoped and reviewed. This is where the actual work happens.
steps.instruction: Execute the implementation plan. Build all items in the approved scope. Follow the pre-flight findings — any architecture or security recommendations must be implemented. Run verification-before-completion after each logical unit.
steps.verification: All planned items complete. Tests pass. No unaddressed pre-flight findings.
steps.validation_prompt: Were all planned items implemented? Do all tests pass? Were all pre-flight findings addressed?

steps.name: QA Pass
steps.description: Run QA on what was built. Verify quality before shipping.
steps.instruction: Run the qa-tester skill in STANDARD mode. Test all critical paths, error handling, and UI states. Produce before/after health scores. If findings P1 or above, route back to fix. Otherwise produce ship-readiness summary.
steps.verification: Health score >= 80/100. All P0/P1 resolved. Ship-readiness is SHIP or CONDITIONAL.
steps.validation_prompt: Is health score >= 80? Are all P0/P1 resolved? Is ship-readiness SHIP or CONDITIONAL?

steps.name: Session Retrospective
steps.description: Log patterns, pitfalls, and learnings from the session. Feed the learnings-keeper.
steps.instruction: Run the session-retro skill. Analyze: what shipped, what failed, what patterns emerged. Log top 3 learnings to learnings-keeper. If this project has prior retros, compare metrics (velocity, test health, rework rate).
steps.verification: Retro document produced. At least 3 learnings logged to learnings-keeper.
steps.validation_prompt: Was a retro document produced? Were at least 3 learnings logged?

variables.name: scope_mode
variables.description: Scope review mode: expansion, selective, hold, reduction
